difficulty_reason: Eight equivalent formulations of quasi-coherence on the affine site of a stack: it explains how condition (2) is read (X_affine carries the chaotic topology, so a sheaf of modules is just a presheaf of modules), gets (1)<=>(2) from Modules on Sites, chaotic-quasi-coherent, shows the tau-sheaf condition for tau in {Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic, fppf} objectwise through the equivalence X_affine_etale/x -> (Aff/U)_etale, and transfers Descent, quasi-coherent-alternative site by site; (8)<=>(7) is settled from the intrinsic character of quasi-coherence. Retained author proof at lines 4775-4796.
